conviction_note: abs_move 18% (median of seven exact prior reactions 19.9%, ATM IV 144% on a chain too wide to use) times a 55% p_up: the lean up comes from a short base that has grown 43% since mid-August into a stock already marked down 6.5% today in sympathy with Insulet, plus healthy Q3 peer channel data. Against that, consensus ($266-271M) sits at or just above the company's own ~$265M Q3 guide, and the reaffirmed full-year range needs a very large Q4. The tubeless 510(k) is still pending and decides the sign more than anything else in this file. The two measurements agree in sign; findings sum +1.4 against the scaled +1.8.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue. Company guide on the Q2 call: ~$265M worldwide (~$180M US, ~$85M intl), GM ~56%, adj. EBITDA margin ~2% (https://www.webull.com/news/15734772929471488, Q2 call transcript 2026-08-06). Street: $265.8M Benzinga, $268.05M Earnings Whispers, $271.24M Chartmill/FXEmpire; EPS -$0.24 to -$0.26 (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/TNDM/estimates, https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/TNDM). FY2026 guide reaffirmed at $1.065-1.085B with FY consensus ~$1.08B (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438133/000143813326000124/ex991-q2earningsrelease2026.htm). H1 actual was $501.8M, so Q3 guide plus the FY range implies Q4 of $298-318M.
positioning_check: Short interest (FINRA via equibles): 15,086,560 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 6.86 days to cover, against 13,369,091 on 09-30, 12,474,385 on 09-15, 11,753,819 on 08-31 and 10,585,732 on 08-14. That is about 21.7% of the 69.6M shares outstanding and +43% since mid-August; the model estimate for 10-30 is 15.9M (https://equibles.com/stocks/tndm/short-interest, read 2026-11-05). This is a crowded short that is still building. Options: the chain is unusable (ATM spread 111% of mid), there is no 25d skew, and put/call OI is 1.18 on 8,227 contracts (sealed baseline). Tape: 5d -10.0%, 20d +13.6%, 37% off the 52w high. Spot $17.81 sits well below the $22.37 close after the Q2 print (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3728310/why-tandem-diabetes-tndm-stock-is-trading-up-today). Intraday on the print day: -6.46% to $17.82 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/TNDM).

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 10.59M shares (2026-08-14) to 15.09M (2026-10-15), +43%, about 21.7% of shares outstanding and 6.86 days to cover, so a growing crowded short goes into a print where this name has moved 16-35% every time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable by line. The last two prints with stable or better guidance and a margin beat (2026-08-06 +19.1%, 2026-02-19 +32.7%) produced outsized up-moves on a heavily shorted base. The prints that disappointed on outlook (2026-05-07 -16.2%, 2025-02-26 -35.3%) fell just as hard, so the short base amplifies in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, but the build since August is not in the sealed baseline. If the market had priced a squeeze, the stock would not sit 20% below its post-Q2 close, and short interest would not still be rising.
findings.independence: AltIndex shows the same 09-30 settlement (13.37M, 5.25 DTC): https://altindex.com/ticker/tndm/short-interest

findings.finding: TNDM fell 6.46% intraday on the print day ($19.05 to $17.82) alongside Insulet's -6.74%, after Insulet's Q3 beat (revenue $842M vs $832.6M consensus, adj. EPS $1.99 vs $1.59, FY guide to the top of the range) and its comment that growth moderates in 2027 as competition rises. Part of TNDM's 5-day -10% is therefore sector de-rating on a peer that beat, not news about Tandem, and it lowers the price bar into the print. Tandem's Mobi Tubeless is one of the 2027 entrants Insulet refers to.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance in the baseline of TNDM falling into its own print on a peer print. TNDM's sealed reactions are all 16-35% in magnitude.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the price: the selloff is the pricing. The question is whether TNDM's own share of it (a competitor saying competition is coming) is a negative for Tandem at all. If the market had read Insulet's comment as positive for the entrant, TNDM would not have fallen in step with PODD.
findings.independence: TNDM's intraday -6.46% on the same day: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/TNDM. Insulet's release dated 2026-11-04: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001145197/000114519726000190/podd2026-09x30ex991.htm. Both rest on one event (the PODD print).

findings.finding: Consensus Q3 revenue of $265.8-271.2M (three sources) sits at or up to 2.4% above the company's own ~$265M Q3 guide from the Q2 call. Q2 revenue landed $0.25M under consensus, so the higher estimates leave little room on the top line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue was in line ($254.56M vs $254.81M) and the stock rose 19.1% on an adj. EBITDA beat ($6.4M vs $3.5M). Revenue alone has not been the line that moved this name; margin and guide have.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public, but the spread across estimate vendors (up to $6M) means part of the street is above the company's number. If that gap were priced, the high-end estimates would have converged on $265M.

findings.finding: Q3 peer channel data was healthy. Beta Bionics Q3 (2026-10-27): pharmacy-benefit revenue +118%, high-30s % of new starts through pharmacy, 69% of starts from MDI, FY guide raised to $124-126M. Insulet US Omnipod +14.7% with total revenue slightly above the top of its guide. Dexcom (2026-10-29) raised FY and cited the G7 15-Day ramp, and G7 15-Day is compatible with Tandem pumps. The pharmacy and MDI-conversion channel Tandem is shifting into (10% of US sales in Q2, targeting ~20% for the year) grew strongly in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 the pharmacy-channel progress and margin from PayGo pricing came with the +19.1% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy: peers spoke after Tandem last did, on 2026-08-06. If the street had carried it into Tandem numbers, estimates would sit above the high end of Tandem's guide rather than spread around it, and the stock would not be trading down with PODD.

findings.finding: MiniMed's fiscal Q1 2027 (quarter to 2026-07-31) showed US sales +13.1% and pump sales +21.5%, credited to the US launch of the MiniMed Flex pump (shipping from June) attracting new patients. That is a tubed-pump competitor in Tandem's core US segment, where Tandem's US pump sales fell 3% in Q2 and new starts were nearly flat year on year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Share-loss worries drove prior selloffs (the 2025 Wells Fargo downgrade on market share loss). In the sealed history, prints with soft US pump numbers (2025-08-06 -19.9%) fell hard.
findings.why_not_priced: MiniMed's quarter overlaps only July with Tandem's Q3, and US pump share is not disclosed per competitor. If it were priced, Tandem's US estimates would have been trimmed below the ~$180M guide; they have not been. This is a proxy, and the rest of the company (international +7%, supplies +14%, pharmacy pricing) has to offset it.
findings.independence: MiniMed 424B3 with the same numbers: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002062583/000162828026064932/minimedgroupinc-424b3.htm (same issuer, one fact).

findings.finding: The Mobi Tubeless 510(k) was submitted in Q2 2026, and management planned a scaled launch in H2 2026 pending clearance, calling 2027 the first full year. No clearance has been announced as of 2026-11-05. A clearance announced with the print, or a firm date, would be the largest upside lever. A slip into 2027 would be a negative. Beta Bionics' Mint patch pump was cleared in September 2026, so the tubeless race is visible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pipeline and guidance prints have driven the largest moves: 2026-02-19 +32.7% on the 2026 outlook and margin, and 2026-05-07 -16.2% when the outlook disappointed. William Blair initiated at Outperform in September specifically on tubeless entry.
findings.why_not_priced: The outcome is binary and unannounced. At this stage it is a question for the call, not a fact. If clearance were expected with the print, Citi and Mizuho would not have cut targets to $18-20 in Sep-Oct.
findings.independence: Q2 release confirms the submission: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438133/000143813326000124/ex991-q2earningsrelease2026.htm. Beta Bionics Mint clearance in Sep 2026: https://www.webull.com/news/15824268921589760

findings.finding: The reaffirmed FY range ($1.065-1.085B) less H1 ($501.8M) less the Q3 guide (~$265M) implies Q4 revenue of $298-318M, a 12-20% sequential step. FY consensus (~$1.08B) sits in the upper half. On the Q2 call an analyst put the H2 US pump growth needed at 12-13% year on year, and management did not confirm it. A cut to the low end, or the range left unchanged with a soft Q4 shape, is the downside path on the line this name trades on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has been the line: 2026-05-07 -16.2% ('full-year guidance disappointed', though reconfirmed), 2025-02-26 -35.3%, 2026-02-19 +32.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public. Consensus at ~$1.08B still assumes the upper half of the range, which needs the Q4 step. If the market doubted it, FY consensus would sit at or below the $1.075B midpoint.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript (Q3 guide, Q4 margin ~60%): https://www.webull.com/news/15734772929471488. FY consensus $1.08B: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/TNDM/estimates

baseline_tension: No skew to read. The 5-day -10% into the print on a crowded and growing short, while peers printed healthy Q3 channel data, supports a mild up lean. Consensus sitting above the company's own Q3 guide, and the large implied Q4, cut against it.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives), applied once per negative: Q3-bar finding -1.0 to -0.8, FY-guide finding -1.0 to -0.8, MiniMed proxy finding -1.0 to -0.7.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): the drawdown here is explained by the PODD sympathy move, which is the pricing itself, so that finding went from +1.0 to +0.7 rather than to zero.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar is sourced to the company's own Q3 guide plus three vendor estimates, so no cap applied.
Left standing: the tubeless finding, the peer-channel finding and the short-interest finding; abs_move and p_up unchanged.
